name: Cali Blaze Tarantula Preroll | Strawberry Lemonade
description:
Sweet strawberry meets tart lemon. Sativa genetics make this one of our best daytime options. The citrus keeps your mind sharp while the strawberry keeps the flavor easy. If you like Strawberry Lemonade the drink, you'll get this.

* Liquid Diamond Infused: Injected with concentrate for amplified potency.
* Kief Crusted: Rolled in kief for an extra layer of flavor and THC.
